fields.title: Cam belt replacement Derby, Ascot Drive

fields.editor:
Your timing belt is a critical component of your car's engine, but it's often overlooked. A worn or damaged timing belt can lead to serious engine problems, including engine failure. That's why it's important to have your timing belt inspected and replaced as needed.

Our expert mechanics will conduct a thorough inspection of your timing belt, pulleys, and tensioner. We'll carefully examine the belt for signs of wear, such as fraying, cracking, or excessive stretching. We'll also inspect the pulleys and tensioner for any damage or misalignment. If we find any issues, we'll recommend the necessary repairs.

If your timing belt needs to be replaced, we'll use high-quality replacement parts and ensure that it's installed correctly. We'll carefully remove the old belt and install the new one, paying close attention to the alignment and tension.

fields.title: DPF cleaning Derby, Ascot Drive

fields.editor:
DPF Cleaning: Breathe New Life into Your Diesel

Is your diesel vehicle struggling with reduced power, increased fuel consumption, or DPF-related warning lights? Our professional DPF cleaning service can help.

DPF filters are essential for capturing harmful soot particles, but over time, they can become clogged, restricting airflow and leading to decreased engine performance, higher emissions, and potentially costly repairs.

Our DPF Cleaning Process:

Comprehensive Inspection: We carefully assess your DPF's condition to determine the most effective cleaning method.

Advanced Cleaning: Utilizing state-of-the-Art equipment and techniques, we thoroughly remove soot and contaminants from your DPF.

Restored Performance: After cleaning, your DPF will operate more efficiently, improving fuel economy, reducing emissions, and restoring your vehicle's power.

fields.title: Hybrid EV servicing Derby, Ascot Drive

fields.editor:
Your hybrid vehicle deserves the same care as a traditional car, with a few extra considerations. Our expert technicians will handle all the routine maintenance, including oil changes, tire rotations, and brake inspections.

Beyond the basics, we'll also meticulously check your hybrid's unique components. This includes the inverter coolant, which keeps the electric motor running smoothly. We'll inspect the charging point for any issues and ensure your battery is in top condition.

**Using advanced diagnostic tools, we'll assess your battery's health, voltage, and state of charge. If needed, we'll recommend maintenance or replacement to keep your hybrid running efficiently.

Schedule a service today and trust our skilled technicians to care for your hybrid. We use the latest technology and follow manufacturer guidelines to provide the best care possible.
